title: Who we are
body: A three-person animation studio built around Mike — a cute character who reacts to life the way you actually feel.

title: What we create
body: Short comedy stories, brand reels and character animation, made for the scroll — 15 seconds, one clear feeling.

title: Why brands stay
body: Mike doesn't sell. He reacts. Your product becomes part of a story people already want to watch again.
